title: coreopsis mutica var. genuina
intro: Coreopsis mutica var. genuina, commonly known as the prairie coreopsis, is a perennial wildflower native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Coreopsis mutica var. genuina include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic, making it a potential treatment for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, coumarins, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
